breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 高致死实体瘤微环境破壁与普惠早筛
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 告别“一经发现即晚期”，打破难治肿瘤的免疫屏障

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推动一滴血极早期泛癌种微创早筛降本普及，开发打破癌巢基质屏障的新型核素偶联/双抗药物、通用型细胞免疫疗法与耐药逃逸实时监测。

master.definition_en: An acute inflammatory process that leads to necrosis of the pancreatic parenchyma. Signs and symptoms include severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, fever, and shock. Causes include alcohol consumption, presence of gallstones, trauma, and drugs.

aliases_zh: 急性出血坏死性胰腺炎
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 胰酶异常激活并引发全身性炎症风暴（SIRS）与腹腔室隔室综合征，早期（发病1-2周内）常在数小时至数日内因持续性呼吸、循环与肾脏多器官功能衰竭致死；后期（>2周）则因胰腺坏死组织继发多重耐药菌感染、脓毒症休克或假性动脉瘤腹腔大出血死亡，ICU总体病死率仍高达10%-30%以上。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 尚无直接阻断胰酶瀑布与炎症风暴的特效靶向药，现行以早期目标导向精准液体复苏、ICU器官支持、早期经鼻空肠营养及坏死感染“升阶梯微创引流（Step-up）”为主导；相比轻症极低死亡率（全住院AP病死率约0.26%），15%-20%演进为重症SAP的患者救治难度大、致死率及致残率依然高企。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021估算全球胰腺炎年死亡约122,420例（按全胰腺炎汇总口径，其中重症/坏死性急性胰腺炎是急性死亡主要构成，重症住院病死率10%-30%+）

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: GBD 2021显示中国胰腺炎标化死亡率自1990年0.98/10万降至2021年0.64/10万，全国年住院约49万例，全住院AP病死率约0.26%，但进展为SAP及感染坏死者病死率高达10%-30%以上

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球急性胰腺炎年发病率约13-45/10万人年，其中约15%-20%进展为合并持续性器官衰竭的重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国近年每年急性胰腺炎住院人次约49万例，受胆石症、高甘油三酯血症及饮酒三重危险因素驱动，其中高脂血症性SAP占比快速攀升且呈年轻化趋势。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 发病最初48-72小时黄金救治：1) 禁食水、有效镇痛并监测腹内压；2) 首选乳酸林格液行适度目标导向补液（避免过度机械扩容加重腹腔高压与肺水肿）；3) 高甘油三酯性（TG>11.3 mmol/L）即刻予胰岛素泵降脂或血浆置换；4) 若伴胆道梗阻性胆管炎立即行急诊ERCP取石引流；5) 机械通气呼吸衰竭、休克及高肌酐早期接入ICU并尽早于24-72小时内恢复经鼻肠内营养维持肠黏膜屏障。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 延迟且微创“升阶梯（Step-up）”清创路径：经皮穿刺置管引流（PCD）或超声内镜经胃/十二指肠穿刺支架引流，再视需要行视频辅助/内镜下腹膜后坏死清创

clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）伴持续器官衰竭或感染坏死需入ICU综合救治、微创清创引流及CRRT等支持，单次住院总费用常高达100,000-300,000元以上（按日常基本医疗支出减负住院及大病保险结算）

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 临床策略方面，WATERFALL试验确立“适度目标补液”优于激进大量输液，可显著降低重症化及液体超负荷死亡风险；2) 靶向药物方面，选择性钙释放激活钙通道（CRAC/Orai1）抑制剂Zegocractin（Auxora）获FDA快速通道并进入2b期CARPO随机对照研究，旨在发病早期直接阻断胰腺腺泡钙超载与肺损伤炎症风暴。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 全球仍无任何一种特异性获批能够阻断腺泡细胞损伤及预防持续性器官衰竭的抗胰腺炎靶向药物；2) 极早期精准识别哪20%患者会迅速恶化为SAP的床旁工具匮乏；3) 中国高甘油三酯血症相关年轻人SAP复发预防及社区长程血脂干预体系薄弱。

breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

Prenatal diagnosis of diaphragmatic hernia and severe lung hypoplasia detected on ultrasonography made the parents opt for termination of the four pregnancies.

master.definition_en: Marchiafava Bignami disease is defined by characteristic demyelination of the corpus callosum (erosion of the protective covering of nerve fibers joining the 2 hemispheres of the brain). The disease seems to most often affect severe and chronic alcoholics in their middle or late adult life. Early symptoms may include depression, paranoia, psychosis, or dementia. Seizures are common, and hemiparesis, aphasia, abnormal movements, and ataxia may sometimesprogress to coma and/or death. The cause of Marchiafava Bignami disease, including the potential role of nutritional deficiency, remains unknown. Improvement and recovery of some individuals has been reported. Treatment focuses on nutritional support and rehabilitation from alcoholism.

master.definition_en: Acute myeloid leukemia with inv(3)(q21;q26.2) or t(3;3)(q21;q26.2) is a subtype of acute myeloid leukemia with recurrent genetic abnormalities characterized by clonal proliferation of myeloid blasts in the bone marrow, blood and, rarely, other tissues. Bone marrow typically shows small, hypolobated megakaryocytes and multilineage dyslplasia. Patients typically present with leukocytosis, anemia, variable platelet counts and a variety of nonspecific symptoms related to ineffective hematopoesis (fatigue, bleeding, bruising, recurrent infections, bone pain) and/or extramedullary site involvement (gingivitis, splenomegaly). High resistance to conventional chemotherapy is reported.

master.definition_en: Any riboflavin transporter deficiency in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the SLC52A3 gene. It is characterized by sensorineural hearing loss and a variety of cranial nerve palsies, usually involving the motor components of the seventh and ninth to twelfth (more rarely the third, fifth, and sixth) cranial nerves. Spinal motor nerves and, less commonly, upper motor neurons are sometimes affected, giving a picture resembling amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. The onset of the disease is usually in the second decade, but earlier and later onset have been reported.

master.definition_en: A HOXA1-related syndrome characterized by horizontal gaze palsy, sensorineural deafness, central hypoventilation, developmental delay, and intellectual disability, described in persons of Athabaskan American Indian heritage. Swallowing dysfunction, vocal cord paralysis, facial paresis, seizures, internal carotid artery, and cardiac outflow tract anomalies may be additionally observed. No dysmorphic facial features are associated.

master.definition_en: A rare visceral arteriovenous malformation characterized by abnormal communications between renal arteries and the venous system. Most cases are asymptomatic but patients may present with clinical symptoms including hematuria, nausea, lumbar and abdominal pain, hypertension, cardiomegaly and high output heart failure. This type of malformation is more commonly reported in females.
